problem_keywords: membranes blowing off studs during installation
use_cases: Attaching vapor control layers to ceiling battens and steel furring channels
Concealed double-sided adhesive lap bonding between overlapping building wrap sheets
Temporarily adhering pliable building membranes to timber or steel wall studs before mechanical fixing
not_for: Single-sided exposed face taping (use single-sided YouRippa or HighTack)
retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorPassive YouRippa Duo Tape is
a heavy-duty, double-sided adhesive tape designed for concealed lap sealing and
temporary positioning of building membranes on structural framing. Featuring
high-tack adhesive on both faces of a carrier with a silicone-coated release
liner, it bonds membranes securely to timber studs, steel girts, and overlapping
sheet runs. It creates a concealed airtight weather seal between membrane layers
while preventing wind flap during frame construction.
